## V3
this approach is way simpler, free and faster, but we will use other LLM features out of N8N

**v3:** no missed jobs between runs, no duplicates, Telegram in HTML (no more `_` workaround), error alerts, tags people on Telegram by job area

**v3.1:** runs every 30 min (jobs from the last 30 min), 5 jobs per search, ATS keywords in the prompt, applicants count in the message

## first things first
open the **Config** node and paste your LinkedIn search links there (as many as you want).

the time filter and sorting are set automatically. the same node sets who gets tagged on Telegram for each job area (RPA, infra, dev / IA / data)

## scraper
**Vagas novas** keeps only real new jobs: drops old ones (Apify fills the result with them when the search is short), drops repeats, and caps at 10 per run

in this version N8N only collects job information, structures the prompt and the data, and lists every relevant information in a google sheet. from here on I chose to stick with a personalized gem on gemini, with an ATS prompt. it's better because we don't get a lot of free tokens + it's easier to get a good looking CV with LaTeX ready to be downloaded as PDF

## Telegram
to bypass the length limit I'm using google docs to put the giant prompt in it XD >:3
feel free to implement your own solution tho

messages go in HTML mode, so `_` in links or titles no longer breaks anything
